subject: Modify JSON Tests to allow connection to external server. (#70)
reason: The change modifies only the module's Python integration-test harness (tst/integration/json_test_case.py, test_json_basic.py, test_rdb.py) to optionally connect to an external server via VALKEY_EXTERNAL_SERVER/VALKEY_HOST/VALKEY_PORT environment variables. No module source code is touched, so the built valkey-json artifact and every JSON command's behavior are identical on both builds; this is test/CI infrastructure with nothing for the fuzzer to exercise.
